On his *"lets use fable well this week"* the conductor put three jobs to Fable (the templates, the cold-run verdict, a whole-library audit) and the rest to Opus; at 12:06 he said *"go for it"*. It committed the borders as `4d62f3c0` at 13:20, and that commit swept in the BD files the committer AC1 had staged when its own commit timed out at 165 s. History was not rewritten.

The conductor built it as version 32 of the "Apollo 304 review" artifact (`notes/_REVIEW-314-the-borders-the-switch-family-the-templates-2026-10-02-v1.html`, 28 calls) and he answered it at 14:55. He kept the light-mode edge invisible, passed four templates by eye, sent five back with comments, parked the wizard, and gave the bento its own lane. SW2 built his three switch-family answers. At 16:53 he paused Fable; every lane after that ran on Opus 5.5.
